title: An execution record is accepted only in EXECUTING, from the lease holder
note: Three readers fold task.execution: the production projection (tasks.check_execution), the independent reconstruction (restated) and the auditor. Each refusal is disabled in turn; the suite holds a genuine governed run as the control, a forged record after the verdict by the verifier, a stranger and the worker, and hand-built lifecycles placing the record before EXECUTING or writing it as a non-holder.

mutations.name: EP1_production_accepts_any_phase
mutations.rationale: the production projection folds an execution record after the verdict, renaming the executor of judged work

mutations.name: EP2_production_accepts_leased
mutations.rationale: a record written before the task is running names the executor of work that has not started

mutations.name: EP3_production_accepts_any_writer
mutations.rationale: an actor that never held the lease names itself the executor

mutations.name: EP4_production_never_asks
mutations.rationale: the rule exists and the projection does not apply it

mutations.name: EP5_reconstruction_accepts_any_phase
mutations.rationale: the second reader folds an out-of-phase record and agrees with a defective primary

mutations.name: EP6_reconstruction_accepts_any_writer
mutations.rationale: the second reader takes a non-holder as the executor

mutations.name: EP7_reconstruction_reports_and_folds
mutations.rationale: the refusal is recorded and the record is folded anyway: the reader tells the truth and believes the lie

mutations.name: EP8_auditor_reports_no_phase_gap
mutations.rationale: the auditor is silent about an execution record the lifecycle has no place for

mutations.name: EP9_auditor_phase_gap_accepts_any_phase
mutations.rationale: the gap's own test is disabled

mutations.name: EP10_auditor_executor_is_the_last_record
mutations.find: if s.action == "task.execution" and verified_by is None:
mutations.rationale: a record after the verdict renames the executor the separation-of-duties check judges, silencing or inventing self-verification
